Beside conducting seminars on environment to broaden, educate and activate the environmental movement, tree planation is done every year. Getting land for tree plantation has been a major challenge to us. To tackle this issue, we have started distributing sapling amongst the villagers. Forest Cleaning District Jalpaiguri State West Bengal District Jalpaiguri States West Bengal Humans have an innate tendency of not trashing garbage, but littering all over. Cleaning of the pristine North Bengal Forest with the Forest Department and students of the area is one of our annual programme. However, it is one of the most preventable and treatable form of cancer, if detected at an early stage. We conduct informative workshops and distribute educational materials to educate the community about the risks associated with Cervical cancer. We conduct free screening camps in collaboration with local healthcare providers. Presently we are also sensitizing the ASHA and Anganwadi Workers block by block of each district. These initiatives have reached a significant number of women in the community, providing them with vital knowledge about cervical cancer and empowering them to take control of their own health Menstrual Hygiene Awareness Camp District Kolkata South 24 Parganas North 24 Parganas Jalpaiguri Hooghly Howrah State West Bengal District Kolkata South 24 Parganas North 24 Parganas Jalpaiguri Hooghly Howrah States West Bengal Menstrual Hygiene Awareness is about more than just access to sanitary pads and appropriate toilets – though those are important. It is also about ensuring women and girls live in an environment that values and supports their ability to manage their menstruation with dignity. All women and girls have the right to menstruate with confidence, with dignity and with support. We raise awareness about the challenges regarding access to menstrual products, education about menstruation and period-friendly sanitation facilities and break the taboos and end the stigma surrounding menstruation. We provide primary health camps with free medication to the underprivileged people in urban slums, remote rural areas and natural disaster zones in collaboration with various hospitals, medical practitioners, Govt. of West Bengal. We provide regular healthcare camps with medication in the Sundarbans and Gorumara Forest in association with Department of Forest, West Bengal. Online classes for the underprivileged children of Sundarbans District South 24 Parganas State West Bengal District South 24 Parganas States West Bengal Education makes responsible citizens! We support Shib Sankar Sisu Niketan, a school in the remote area of the Sundarbans, by providing online classes to their students as a part of their school curriculum. We have set up a studio in Kolkata, equipped with Smart Board, from where reputed teachers from Kolkata try to invoke interest in education among the underprivileged students by introducing them to real-time e-learning with help of audios and videos, multimedia, images, online web conferences, PPT presentations, 2D & 3D animations, etc..
